run_info.experiment: On a noisy IBM chip: pruning, readout mitigation and post-selection
run_info.estimates: trailing 3 years of daily prices before each date; Bayes-Stein returns, Ledoit-Wolf risk
run_info.costs: each market's rate card, for its default amount of money split over k stocks, held one year
run_info.dates: first trading day of every second quarter from 2019
run_info.procedure: tune once on the ideal simulator, then sample on each chip noise model (AerSimulator.from_backend)
run_info.mitigation: two calibration circuits (all 0s, all 1s) on the same physical qubits; each qubit's 2×2 misread table inverted
run_info.postselection: keep shots with exactly k stocks
run_info.lift: chance of the best portfolio divided by a blind legal guess's chance (as qapital.core.metrics.grade)
